subject: Journal entry for credit claim VEN033-0014
body:
Dear Accounts lead,

Record: VEN033-0014
Finding: VEN033-0014 appears in GSTR-2B for 2025-10, not 2025-09.
Why: The supplier reported the invoice one return period late, so the Rs 61,644 credit can be claimed only in that month.
Next step: Claim the credit in the month it appears in GSTR-2B.
Amount involved: Rs 61,644.
